verdict.rationale: Gumloop agents can run without the UI. Webhook triggers let any HTTP POST from a cron job or internal script start an agent, and the API plus Python and JavaScript SDKs can create agents, start sessions and retrieve outputs, authenticated with team-scoped API keys passed as bearer tokens. Scheduled triggers add unattended recurring runs. Missing for 10: no documented CI-pipeline integration (e.g. a GitHub Actions example), no evidenced headless CLI mode, no published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
